description: Add or update a sealed product in the authenticated user's inventory by setting its absolute quantity (upserts the row for that product). This is a real write and is Premium-gated. Use remove_sealed_inventory to delete a row. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

quantity.description: Absolute quantity to set for this product.

sealedProductUuid.description: Sealed product UUID. Get it from get_sealed_products or get_sealed_product.

name: set_sealed_inventory
